data.gender_notes: Vin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'vinum', meaning 'wine' or 'victory'. In Christian tradition, the name Vin is a symbol of triumph and strength. The name was borne by several saints and early Christian martyrs. The name Vin carries the meaning “Victory, Power, Strong” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Vin usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, power, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name infused with the power of victory and the strength of faith.
data.etymology: Vin belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory, Power, Strong.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vin total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
